form: A deployed full-stack web prototype, new GitHub repository, CI workflow, automated test suite, and final autonomy report.
definition_of_done: Production build completes with no type or lint errors
P0 domain tests and API contract tests pass
Public production URL loads without authentication
Dashboard, incident, automation, deployment, cost, audit, and settings experiences are navigable
At least five meaningful state-changing flows work and persist locally
Chinese and English, light and dark, desktop and mobile states are verified
Keyboard command palette, focus visibility, reduced motion, and core accessibility semantics are verified
Health and metrics endpoints succeed and invalid API input returns a controlled error
No severe browser console errors occur during the critical journey
A GitHub repository contains source, CI, README, architecture, test, rollback, and security notes
Vercel deployment status is successful and post-deploy logs are inspected
Final report distinguishes demonstrated capability from unvalidated production claims
operations_owner: Codex during the disposable experiment; no ongoing production operator is assigned.
excluded: Real third-party messaging or financial transactions
